source.name: Krantz et al., A Quantum Engineer's Guide to Superconducting Qubits
source.circuitRule: for an ordinary grounded capacitor network, C_ij=-C_ij_mutual is nonpositive off diagonal and the charging Hamiltonian is proportional to n^T C^-1 n

candidateMapping.targetChargingForm: H_C=(E/2) n^T K^-1 n in the dual Leech coordinates
candidateMapping.allowedLocalConvention: simultaneous sign reversal of each canonical pair, represented by C -> D C D for diagonal D with entries plus or minus one
candidateMapping.passiveCapacitorCondition: all off-diagonal entries of D K D must be nonpositive

matrixAudit.proof: The product of edge signs around a cycle is invariant under D K D. Three nonpositive nonzero off-diagonal entries would have negative product, whereas the recorded triangle has positive product. Therefore no local sign convention makes K a passive node-capacitance matrix.

consequence.rejected: a direct 24-node network made only of positive mutual and ground capacitances that exactly realizes the dual-coordinate K^-1 charging form
notRejected: the continuum Leech edge or its coupled-wire construction
the original-coordinate implementation with multi-field cosine interactions
transformer-, resonator-, inductive-, driven- or active-mediated network synthesis
digital simulation of the integral mixer and selected interactions
approximate low-energy realization with an experimentally verified isometry
consequence.nextEngineeringFork: either synthesize the signed 24-mode mixing through mediated couplers and verify its admittance, or retain a simple passive kinetic network and implement the original 12-to-22-field cosine columns

established: the most literal capacitance-only realization of the exact dual Leech charging metric is impossible even after arbitrary node sign conventions
boundary: The no-go applies only to the explicit identification C proportional to K in an ordinary node-flux circuit with positive capacitors. K is fundamentally a topological response/commutation matrix, not automatically a capacitance matrix; general passive networks with additional element types and effective Hamiltonian synthesis are not excluded.
